newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission sets "C" sugar non-export penalties.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission sets "C" sugar non-export penalties.

text.p: The European Commission on Wednesday set annual penalties for 1995/96 for "C" or non-quota sugar not exported to the world market, an EU official said on Thursday.

"So-called non-quota C sugar which is produced excess to quota sugar must be exported by December 31 each year and if it is not it is presumed to have been sold on the domestic market and becomes subject to a penalty payment," the official said.

The penalty for white sugar was 59.26 Ecus per 100 kg and that for isoglucose was 62.51 Ecus/100 kg (dry matter content). No penalty was set for inulin syrup as there was no C non-quota production in 1995/96.
The Commission did not present new beet sugar production estimates, as had been expected. New figures are now expected in two weeks, the official said. --Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
